name: BOGausS Optimizer
definition: A modified Stochastic Gradient Descent optimizer that ensures unbiased state estimation for sparsely-viewed and split Gaussians, using precision-aware updates for localization and size parameters.
summary: BOGausS Optimizer is a modified SGD optimizer for 3D Gaussian Splatting that ensures unbiased state estimation for sparsely-viewed Gaussians using Gaussian-dependent time steps and precision-aware scaling factors.
